label.zh: 步数（Ref2VA Turbo：lightx2v 8 步 → 请求 9）

hint.zh: 参考生视频走 Ref2VA 专用的 lightx2v turbo 8 步 LoRA（bootstrap 里离线合并进 Ref2VA transformer）。与 FL2VA 的 9 步同理：请求＝sigma 网格点数＝去噪次数+1，故默认 8 次去噪 → 9。改动会偏离蒸馏调度。
hint.en: Reference-to-video uses the Ref2VA-specific lightx2v turbo 8-step LoRA (offline-merged into the Ref2VA transformer at bootstrap). Same convention as FL2VA's 9: request = sigma grid points = denoise evals + 1, so 8 evals → 9. Changing it deviates from the distilled schedule.

label.zh: 负向词（仅当引导强度 > 1 时生效）

hint.zh: 最长边像素，默认 1024，短边按画幅推导：只下调不超分。最长边 ≤1024 为整图 VAE 解码（与本地一致）；1536 / 2048 在 48GB 档上必须走分块解码，块边界可能有拼缝/色斑，画质有折损。
hint.en: Longest-edge pixels, default 1024; the short edge follows the aspect ratio. Only down-scaling. At or below 1024 the VAE decodes in one pass (same as local); 1536 / 2048 must tile on 48GB GPUs, which can leave seams and color blotches.
